status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Eagles placed Stowers (quadriceps/hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.
status.longComment: Stowers has been dealing with a hamstring injury since at least Aug. 24, which limited him in all three Week 1 practices before the Eagles tabbed him as questionable for Sunday's season opener against the Commanders. At the same time the team placed him on IR, he was ruled out with not only the hamstring issue but a quad concern. The rookie second-round pick thus will miss at least the first four games of the campaign, allowing Johnny Mundt and E.J. Jenkins to handle the TE reps that don't go to No. 1 option Dallas Goedert.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Dickerson (knee) was placed on injured reserve by the Eagles on Monday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
status.longComment: Dickerson struggled in the team's regular-season opener against the Commanders on Sunday, and he now appears to be in need of some time away while nursing a knee issue. The offensive lineman is first eligible to return to action Week 6 versus Carolina on Oct. 18, and in the meantime, Drew Kendall or Willie Lampkin will likely be asked to step in as the team's starting left guard.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Sam (foot) reverted to the Eagles' injured-reserve list Monday, Andrew DiCecco of InsideTheBirds.com reports.
status.longComment: The Eagles waived Sam with an injury designation Sunday after he suffered a foot injury during Friday's preseason finale against the Bengals. The safety cleared waivers and will now spend the entirety of the 2026 regular season on IR unless he is waived with an injury designation.
